verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Jules has an API for custom workflows (jules-docs-9, jules-docs-11) and lets you review plans, diffs and PRs for individual coding tasks (jules-docs-4, jules-docs-7, jules-docs-8). Nothing shows that automation definitions themselves can be versioned, reviewed as changes, or rolled back. PR review covers the code a task produces, not the automation that produced it, so the applicable axis is unevidenced.
